doc: M2-FP-102 (the human's playtest: placeholder villagers): HalunaVillagers (game/levels/ch02/haluna/haluna_villagers.gd) gives each of Haluna's villager bodies a FieldNpc (M3-CRE-610, docs/kb/tech/field_npc.md) with its M2-CHR-03 actor, so they idle out of step, breathe, turn to Rhen and talk instead of standing as capsules. body: the StaticBody3D's path in haluna.tscn (it keeps its collision; the FieldNpc is its child, so night_hide still removes it). npc_id: the npc.json tuning row and the idle phase. actor: the villager's actor scene. talk: the Interactable beside the body (a sibling under the same parent) whose use starts the talk. hide: the stand-in meshes the actor replaces (a row's own hide adds to it). stand_in_for: a body with no model of its own wears another villager's until Character builds one (request M2-CHR-100).
